subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this PR as the answer-candidate Activity slice of native Codex progress visibility, or fold it back into the broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039 design?
rationale: The implementation has useful proof, but the PR is dirty against main and the remaining choice is the supported Control UI product surface for native Codex progress rather than a purely mechanical code repair.

options.title: Sponsor a rebase and port
options.body: Ask for the PR to be rebased onto current main, ported to `ui/src/pages/activity/*`, and cleaned up for locale output while preserving the existing Gateway-backed proof shape.

options.title: Fold into the broader issue
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039 as the canonical design target and close or pause this PR after preserving its proof and tests as reference material.

options.title: Defer answer-candidate Activity
options.body: Decide that answer candidates should not become a first-class Activity entry until the full native Codex progress surface is designed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebase and port
recommendation.body: Ask for the PR to be rebased onto current main, ported to `ui/src/pages/activity/*`, and cleaned up for locale output while preserving the existing Gateway-backed proof shape.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on both the Codex projector and delivery semantics that decide whether this UI signal is product-ready.
